notes.title: A Bit of Housekeeping
notes.notes:
The card that was mistakenly left in the game has now been properly removed.
In addition, several scene-related issues have been addressed: the kitchen doors should now behave as intended, interactions with the bedroom computer have been improved, and the office binders have been corrected.
Thank you once again for your continued support and thoughtful feedback – it truly helps us make the experience better with each update.

notes.title: Ultrawide Support Added!
notes.notes:
Good news for ultrawide users!
The game now fully supports ultrawide resolutions, with improved screen scaling and UI adjustments. Dive into the experience with a wider, more immersive view!

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Fullscreen & Resolution Bug Fix
notes.notes:
We’ve just released a patch that fixes issues related to fullscreen mode and screen resolution settings. The game should now launch and switch display modes more reliably, with proper support for various screen sizes.

Thanks to everyone who reported these problems — your input is super helpful! If anything still seems off, don’t hesitate to reach out.

notes.title: More Achievement Fixes
notes.notes:
Another patch is live! This update addresses additional issues with achievements not unlocking as they should. Everything should now trigger correctly once the conditions are met.

Huge thanks to everyone who took the time to report these — your feedback is super valuable. Let us know if you run into anything else!

notes.title: Achievement Unlock Bug Fix
notes.notes:
We've just released an update that fixes an issue preventing some achievements from unlocking properly. If you experienced this bug, things should now work as intended!

Thanks to everyone who reported it — your feedback really helps us improve the game. If you notice anything else, feel free to reach out!

notes.title: Achievement Unlock Bug Fix
notes.notes:
We've just released an update that fixes an issue preventing some achievements from unlocking properly. If you experienced this bug, things should now work as intended!

Thanks to everyone who reported it — your feedback really helps us improve the game. If you notice anything else, feel free to reach out!

notes.title: Update - Audio Options Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

In this update, we’ve fixed an issue with the Mute button and the volume sliders in the game’s options. Audio controls should now work properly for a better experience!

Keep sending us your feedback—it’s essential for making the game even better.

notes.title: Where’s My Hentai Deck & Where’s My Bara Deck – Now Available!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that Where’s My Hentai Deck and Where’s My Bara Deck are officially released!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45453949/2a6e474e1ff13c2509674e02bcbf90faa7fc01d9.jpg[/img]
[h1]Where’s My Hentai Deck[/h1]
A straight-themed hidden object game where you search for your lost hentai deck scattered around the house.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3515540/Wheres_my_Hentai_Deck

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45453949/29c4495e7dd6fc42ae5e43a2edebf110868164bf.jpg[/img]
[h1]Where’s My Bara Deck[/h1]
A bara-themed version where you must find your bara deck, hidden in various spots.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3520290/Wheres_my_Bara_Deck

Both games offer a fun and spicy hidden object experience!

We also want to sincerely apologize for forgetting to apply the initial launch discount for Where’s My Bara Deck. This was an oversight on our part, and we appreciate your understanding.

Thank you for your support! We hope you enjoy the games!
